lastGame.title: Bills 33, Raiders 30
stats: Josh Allen: 255 pass yds, 2 TD — his 258th career TD pass ties Jim Kelly's Bills record
James Cook: 22 carries, 95 yds, TD + 3 catches for 58 yds
TD catches for Keon Coleman (shovel pass) and Khalil Shakir (9-yd screen)
Dorian Williams: first career interception, off Kirk Cousins
Tyler Bass 38-yd FG made it 33-23; Bills recovered the onside kick to close it

news.h: Lamar Jackson trending toward a return
news.b: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Jackson (high ankle sprain, three straight games missed) is in a "decent spot" to play Sunday in Buffalo, with more known after Wednesday's practice.
Buffalo has won 11 straight games coming off its bye, a run dating to 2015, and Josh Allen has never lost after a bye. Sunday is Joe Brady's first post-bye game as head coach.

news.h: Franklin wins appeal, cleared for Ravens
news.b: The NFL reduced Sam Franklin Jr.'s one-game spitting suspension to a $14,926 fine after hearing officer James Thrash ruled on his appeal on Oct. 23. He is eligible to face Baltimore on Nov. 1.
C.J. Gardner-Johnson's one-game suspension was upheld on appeal, and he was also fined $11,194 for unnecessary roughness against the Raiders. He will sit out the Ravens game.

source: ESPN standings and DraftKings odds (Oct 31); record, results and news carried over from Oct 30 (no games since the bye).
